$comment: ETF coverage universe. DATA ONLY — this file names which funds the Center covers and how TradeAlphaAI classifies them. It deliberately contains NO factual claims about the funds (no TER, ISIN, issuer, benchmark, domicile, replication, distribution or inception): those are resolved at build time from a provider response or marked awaiting verified data. Adding a fund means adding an entry here; no code change is required.
$comment_scale: The pipeline is built to scale: builders fetch concurrently with an on-disk cache, similarity is bucketed rather than all-pairs, and bulky series are sharded out of the main artifact. Thousands of entries here are supported.
